text:
eva_pm: Heads up — competitor dropped a routing+embeddings bundle this morning. Customers on our pilot called asking if we can match the price/latency for small tenants.
chris_eng: saw it. their offering looks like a single-model combo + cheap vector store. We don't have anything that low-cost at the moment.
maya_prod: we need a quick decision: do we push for feature parity (cheap bundle) or lean into our reliability/differentiator story? Cost matters to a few SMB pilots.
liam_design: from UX POV, a 'lite' mode for tenant config could keep things simple. toggle: "economy" vs "default".
anita_sales: most SMBs ask for predictable monthly price + SLA. They'd trade some latency for a flat fee. Can we offer a simple packaging option to sales ASAP?
sam_ds: there's a low-effort path: serve a smaller quantized model + prefix caching. Quality drop is measurable but might be acceptable for chat summaries.
chris_eng: engineering concerns: adding a new "economy" routing lane needs kernel/quantization work + autoscaler tweaks. Quick hack: route economy traffic to preemptible spot nodes with scaled-down batch size.
eva_pm: @chris can you estimate a minimal viable config for that hack? we have a customer renewal in 3 weeks.
chris_eng: rough sketch: 
```
routing:
  lanes:
    - name: economy
      model: small-q4
      nodes: spot-pool
      batch: 8
      cache: prefix-locked
```
This is ~2 engineer-weeks to wire safely + canary.
maya_prod: launch criteria proposal: 1) <200ms median for 512 tokens on economy; 2) documented 10% quality delta vs default; 3) rollback knob + canary to 5% traffic. Thoughts?
anita_sales: that sounds sellable. Add a simple price tier sheet and FAQ about tradeoffs.
andrew_head: caution — don't race to parity on price if it corrodes margins. We need a playbook: short-term shim + medium-term differentiated product that preserves unit economics.
sam_ds: medium-term: invest in quant-aware model selection + embedding compression. That reduces cost without sacrificing our SLOs.
chris_eng: agree. Immediate plan = implement economy lane as a controlled experiment with hard limits. Parallel track = Optimize kernels/quant path.
liam_design: I'll draft minimal UI copy: "Economy mode — lower cost, reduced fidelity". Need microcopy for fallback behavior.
eva_pm: decision check: MVP experiment approved if we scope to one pilot region and add canary. @ops-bot create incident channel and a canary alert for economy lane.
ops-bot: created channel #incidents/economy-canary-3998765432 and set alerts: latency >250ms, error rate >1%.
anita_sales: timeline ask: can we have a demo for the renewal next Tuesday?
chris_eng: tight but possible if we freeze scope today. I'd say beta demo (no billing) by next Tue.
maya_prod: I'll own rollout comms + FAQ. @andrew_head want a 15m review before demo.
andrew_head: scheduled. Great work team — short-term experiment + medium-term investment. Keep decision notes in the roadmap doc and tag affected tickets.
eva_pm: thanks — I'll update roadmap slice and sync with growth.\liam_design: dropping initial mock in the product drive: https://drive.mock/economy-mode-v1
chris_eng: adding PRD pointers into #eng-runtime and linking test checklist.
eva_pm: thread closed for now — reopen if new blockers come up. :rocket:
